review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines 13 numeric rational substitutes and 13 rounded substitutes (`manuscriptNormV8_kSubstituteRat` and `manuscriptNormV8_kRoundedSubstituteRat`). It also defines the two row sums, plus interval, error and sum-bound lemmas. Each definition is a specific instance of the project's own `barrierWeightedComplexLogRat` or `manuscriptRoundedWeightedComplexLogRat` at fixed rational parameters. The row sums are plain `+` chains. I found no independent declaration here that re-implements a Mathlib concept such as a general interval, a finite sum or an absolute-value bound. The repeated per-term copies are a proof-structure and duplication issue, not a competing-concept issue, so they fall outside this rubric. I did not search Mathlib for the helper definitions defined in other files, because they are not part of the target. Any redundancy in those would belong to those files.
